data.content_ref: inline:SRC_005 reduces to a degenerate case of SRC_002: SRC_002 carries the full standard decomposition (720 + 7×27 = 909 in its mechanism) yet collapses to SRC_005's $846 output, so SRC_005 depends on SRC_002 by inheriting its parameter space (base rate, OT rate, threshold) but setting the OT premium to zero — making SRC_005 a boundary case where SRC_002's own countercondition fires. Refuted if SRC_002's mechanism genuinely yields $846 without any premium-suppression step, or if the two share no common parameter structure.
